newsitem.title: USA: GRC International stock tumbles on growing losses.
newsitem.headline: GRC International stock tumbles on growing losses.

text.p: The stock of GRC International tumbled Friday, a day after the diversified company reported burgeoning losses and said it would sell its Advanced Products division to cut costs and return to profitability.
The stock fell 75 cents or more than 16 percent to $3.875 on the New York Stock Exchange in early afternoon trading.

On Thursday, GRC said its losses grew to $19.1 million, or $2.05 a share, in the second quarter ended Dec. 31 from $318,000, or 3 cents a share, in the year-ago period. Revenues rose to $30.3 million from $28.3 million.
The latest results include a $14.3 million write-down for deferred software costs, the Vienna, Va.-based company said.
"These expense reductions," said GRC International President Jim Roth, "are over and above the $1 million operating reductions we announced last month for our product businesses.
